challenge: Mild, cloudy Monday in New Buffalo, around 60°F by noon with light wind. It's labs eve, so keep it moderate: a controlled Total Gym full-body session with nothing to failure, plus an easy walk.
constraint: Labs are Tue Oct 27, 10:20 AM. Keep training moderate (nothing to failure) today. Hold Omega-D3, Centrum Silver and IM8 today and tomorrow; no creatine tomorrow morning.
items: Total Gym full-body, moderate: 3 x 12 squats, 3 x 10 rows, 3 x 10 chest press, 2 x 12 pull-ups (incline you can control), stop 2-3 reps short of failure
Easy 45 min walk, midday to early afternoon (~58–60°F, light wind)
20 min easy kayak if the lake is calm, dress for cold water (optional)
